name: PubChem PUG REST API (NIH)
description: NIH chemical and bioactive database offering official compound descriptions, biological roles, safety summaries, and pharmacology reference links.

name: MedlinePlus Web Service (NIH / NLM)
description: Official US National Library of Medicine free-text health topic search — returns authoritative dietary supplement and vitamin summary pages under medlineplus.gov. Note: this endpoint returns XML, not JSON (the old connect.medlineplus.gov/service endpoint took standardized diagnosis/procedure codes, not free-text ingredient names, and could never actually resolve a plain ingredient name like "Vitamin C" — see resource_fetcher.py's _query_medlineplus).

name: USDA FoodData Central API
description: Official US Department of Agriculture database for exact nutrient compositions and standard intake baselines. `api_key` above is the checked-in fallback (rate-limited DEMO_KEY) — resource_fetcher.py's _query_usda overrides it at request time with the USDA_API_KEY environment variable when set.

name: DailyMed Label Database (NIH / NLM)
description: Official NLM repository for dietary supplement product labels, active ingredients, and manufacturer safety disclosures.

name: Europe PMC Open Access (EMBL-EBI)
description: European Molecular Biology Laboratory repository providing open-access scientific monographs, systematic reviews, and regulatory papers. resource_fetcher.py's _query_europe_pmc builds the actual `query` value as "{ingredient_name} AND (monograph OR review)" rather than using the bare ingredient name from this config's query_param, and filters results to isOpenAccess == "Y" only. `resultType: core` (rather than `lite`) is needed to get `abstractText` back for the resource's summary.

name: Licensed Natural Health Products Database (Health Canada)
description: Official Canadian government regulatory database containing safety monographs, approved health claims, and dosage limits.
